name: Grasshopper on the Green
whyLine: KentOnline reports that regulars Mike and Nicola Vigar have bought this "beloved" pub on Westerham green and want to keep its "old-school" character for the long term.
note: On the green, Westerham. Purchase completed 16 Sep 2026, and Mike Vigar has been landlord since Oct 2025. Not a 2026 opening, so filed as hidden-gem. CAMRA listing camra.org.uk/pubs/grasshopper-on-the-green-westerham-128440 (undated). Westerham has no rail station. WebFetch was down, so details come from search snippets only.

name: The Garibaldi
whyLine: Volunteer-run Victorian local whose community group completed buying the freehold in August, a rescue SUSY Radio headlined "Redhill community saves local pub".
note: Run by The Garibaldi Community Pub CIC. A Surrey Live story (getsurrey.co.uk/news/surrey-news/160-year-old-redhill-pubs-34497803, exact date not confirmed so not cited) says the freehold purchase completed on 7 Aug 2026. CAMRA listing camra.org.uk/pubs/garibaldi-redhill-191301 calls it a small single-room Victorian pub. Street address and nearest station were not confirmed. WebFetch was down, so details come from search snippets only.
